top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a simple, general and now well understood mechanism: a Z2 invariant in a time-reversal-invariant spin-orbit insulator forces protected helical edge states, a state of matter distinct from the integer quantum Hall lineage honoured in 2016. Kane and Mele supplied the concept, Molenkamp the first quantised edge conductance in HgTe wells, and independent confirmation (ARPES, STM, 3D generalisations, transfer to photonics and cold atoms) shows maturity. The BHZ attribution gap is real but bounded if the citation is anchored on the prediction of the state and its first observation. P001 (optical lattice clocks) has cleaner credit and is a genuine new concept, so it ranks second; P003 (IceCube) is a solid discovery with a less secure three-name allocation and citation scope; no award is last because several mature, deserving candidates exist.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; same-city Gothenburg ties to colleagues Johansson and Olsson (Chalmers) are institutional only, with no specific collaboration with any proposed laureate.
